q: How does a Surat diamond polishing unit count its electricity emissions?
title: Surat diamond unit: electricity CO2
short: Multiply the kWh on each month's electricity bill by the CEA grid factor of 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. That is the unit's Scope 2. Divide by carats polished in the month if a buyer wants a per-carat making figure, and say that it covers your electricity only.
audience: Natural diamond cutting and polishing units in the Surat diamond cluster of Gujarat

p: Add kWh from every meter the unit pays for.
Multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 (CEA, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0).
Divide by carats polished in the same month.
Mining and rough supply sit in Scope 3 and are usually far larger than polishing. Label your figure as the polishing step only.

example.title: Worked example: one month (illustrative inputs)
lines: Per carat: 8,520 / 400 = 21.3 kg CO2 per carat
example.note: Quantities are illustrative; use your bills and the polishing register.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
